facts.text: Eat well tonight, lads. There's bread, mutton and plenty of ale, and we ride at first light.
facts.why: Wallace never says this. The quote page lists his real lines and none is about bread, mutton or ale. It is printed in quote marks as his words.
facts.fix: Every man dies. Not every man really lives.

vibe.verdict: The food is Scottish and well chosen, but the army mess hall layout and bugle call feel like a modern camp, not medieval Scotland.
